title: Five hundred pages
logline: The garage floor covered in the phantom novel. The dog walks across it. Gully asks what it is.

panels.composition: The garage floor, every inch: loose pages. Hundreds. Pencil, ink, some watercolor. WOOD in the middle on his knees, sorting. BARNABY walking across them.

image.prompt: a garage floor completely covered in hundreds of loose drawn pages, a young man kneeling among them sorting, a small dog walking across them, muddy digital flats

panels.composition: GULLY in the door, a bag of maple bars. Stopping.

image.prompt: a young man in a backwards cap stopped in a garage doorway holding a paper bag, looking at a floor covered in pages

panels.composition: Wood, holding up two pages that don't match. A noir panel. A travelogue panel.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man holding up two drawn pages that clearly belong to different books, one dark noir, one a sunny travel sketch

panels.composition: Wood, still holding them. Gully waiting. The dog has lain down on the pages. The strip cuts before the answer.

image.prompt: a young man holding two mismatched pages with his mouth open to explain, a friend waiting in the doorway, a dog lying down on the pages, the answer not arriving
image.notes: 'Of what.' The strip never answers. Cut mid-word.

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Five hundred pages of five different books. 'Of what.' Cut before the answer.
